query_text: Where can I buy the latest iPhone?

action.query: Apple iPhone latest model buy official
queries: Apple iPhone latest model buy official

annotations.title: Apple iPhone 16 128GB Apple Intelligence (Unlocked) Ultramarine MYDC3LL/A - Best Buy

content.text:
You can buy the latest iPhone directly from **Apple** online or in an Apple Store. As of now, Apple’s current lineup includes **iPhone 17** models, and Apple has an official “Buy iPhone 17” page. ([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/buy-iphone/iphone-17?utm_source=openai))

Good places to buy in the U.S.:

- **Apple Store / Apple.com** — best for unlocked models, trade-in, Apple Card financing, setup help, and carrier activation. ([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/buy-iphone/iphone-17?utm_source=openai))  
- **Your carrier** — Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, etc.; often best if you want monthly bill credits or trade-in promos.  
- **Best Buy** — convenient for in-store pickup and carrier deals; their listings update frequently. ([bestbuy.com](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/apple-iphone-16-128gb-apple-intelligence-unlocked-ultramarine/JJGCQ866W3?utm_source=openai))  
- **Costco / Sam’s Club / Walmart / Target** — sometimes have gift-card or activation promos, depending on carrier and availability.

If you want the safest/easiest option: **buy from Apple.com and choose “unlocked”** unless you specifically want a carrier promotion.
